content: लिङ्गम् [लिङ्ग्-अच्] .²1 A mark, sign, token, an emblem, a badge, symbol, distinguishing mark, characteristic; यतिपार्थिवलिङ्गधारिणौ <ls>R. 8. 16</ls>; अथवा प्रावृषेण्यैरेव लिङ्गैर्मम राजोपचारः संप्रति <ls>V. 4</ls>; मुनिर्दोहदलिङ्गदर्शी <ls n="V.">14. 71</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 30</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 25</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 8.">252</ls>. .²2 A false or unreal mark, a guise, disguise, a deceptive badge; लिङ्गैर्मुदः संवृतविक्रियास्ते <ls>R. 7. 30</ls>; क्षपणकलिङ्गधारी <ls>Mu. 1</ls>; न लिङ्गं धर्मकारणम् <ls>H. 4. 85</ls>. See लिङ्गिन् below. .²3 A symptom, mark of disease. .²4 A means of proof, a proof, evidence. .²5 (In logic) The {%hetu%} or middle term in a syllogism; particularly the assertion of the {%hetuʼs%} being found in the पक्ष or minor term coupled with the statement of the invariable concomitance between this {%hetu%} and the major term; it is thus defined:-- व्याप्तिपक्षधर्मतावल्लिङ्गम् <ls>Tarka K.</ls> .²6 The sign of gender or sex. .²7 Sex; गुणाः पूजास्थानं गुणिषु न च लिङ्गं न च वयः <ls>U. 4. 11</ls>. .²8 The male organ of generation. .²9 Gender (in <ab>gram.</ab>) .²10 The genital organ of Śiva worshipped in the form of a Phallus. .²11 The image of a god, an idol; धत्तेऽसावात्मनो लिङ्गं मायया विसृजन् गुणान् <ls>Bhāg. 7. 2. 22</ls>. .²12 One of the relations or indications (such as संयोग, वियोग, साहचर्य <ab>&c.</ab>) which serve to fix the meaning of a word in any particular passage; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} in कुपितो मकरध्वजः the word कुपित restricts the meaning of मकरध्वज to ‘Kāma’; see <ls>K. P. 2</ls> and commentary {%ad loc.%}; तदेव सक्तः सह कर्मणैति लिङ्गं मनो यत्र निषक्तमस्य <ls>Bṛ. Up. 4. 4. 6</ls>. .²13 (In Vedānta <ab>phil.</ab>). The subtle frame or body, the indestructible original of the gross or visible body; <ab>cf.</ab> पञ्चकोष; यं योगिनो योगसमाधिना रहो ध्यायन्ति लिङ्गादसुतो मुमुक्षया <ls>Bhāg. 3. 19. 28</ls>. .²14 A spot, stain. .²15 The nominal base, the crude form of a noun (प्रातिपदिक). .²16 (In <ab>Sāṅ. phil.</ab>) Pradhāna or Prakṛti; <ab>q. v.</ab> .²17 The effect or product (that which is evolved out of a primary cause and itself becomes a producer). .²18 Inference, conclusion; अव्यक्तमिति विज्ञेयं लिङ्गग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् <ls>Mb. 12. 189. 15</ls>. .²19 = उपाधि; योगेन धृत्युद्यमसत्त्वयुक्तो लिङ्गं व्यपोहेत् कुशलोऽहमाख्यम् <ls>Bhāg. 5. 5. 13</ls>.
